detailed_descriptions_html.en:
TUNG. TUNG. TUNG.

He hears the island. He hears you.

Tung Tung Tung Sahur does not stop. He does not tire. He does not forget where you ran.

Little Sahur Island is his domain, and every sound you make, every snapped branch, every kicked stone, every panicked breath, is an invitation. Learn his patterns. Respect his persistence. Or don't make it to morning.

KEY FEATURES:

  • An island that wants to trap you. Explore a fully realized 1km × 1km open environment with dense biomes, hidden structures, and secrets that reward the brave and punish the reckless.

  • Scavenge to survive. Hunt down scattered boat parts across the entire island. Every component brings you one step closer to freedom, if you can reach it.

  • A relentless pursuer. Tung Tung Tung Sahur actively hunts you across the island. No safe rooms. No sanctuaries. Only distance, darkness, and luck.

  • Dynamic tension. Manage noise, light, and movement as you scavenge. The tools that help you find parts are the same ones that give you away.

Can you repair the boat before he finds you?

Little Sahur Island remembers everyone who came. It has yet to let anyone leave.
